blocks.html: CareHub is where Hinge Health’s physical therapists and coaches work with members every day. I was the lead IC on its visual refresh, from the member record to the visual system behind it.

blocks.label: My role at a glance
items: I led the design of the refresh, end to end.
Me and one more designer, over six months.
The work was recognised with a Mover’s Award.

blocks.alt: The earlier CareHub member record: tabs, a summary card, engagement and pain data, and the conversation on the right.
The refreshed CareHub member record: a labelled navigation rail, an AI summary at the top, engagement, trends, the current focus with a body map, and the conversation.

items: What needs attention comes first. A summary at the top states the member’s need, with the notes behind it.
Progress at a glance. Engagement by week sits beside pain and PSFS trends.
The plan in view. The current focus, with the treated regions marked on a body map.
Clear navigation. A labelled rail for Home, Search, Queue and Next.

blocks.html: The refresh brought typography, colour, icons and reusable components into one visual language.

blocks.alt: A 10-second tease of CareHub 2.0: the earlier member record sweeping into the refreshed one, then its icons, its body-map illustration and its colour families.
blocks.cap: CareHub 2.0 in 10 seconds. Below, the system board: select any piece to see it full size.

pieces.label: Noto Sans typography
pieces.note: One typeface across the workspace, from names and notes to clinical numbers.

pieces.label: Colour tokens
pieces.note: Named fills in families (neutral, neutral dark and brand), each in primary, secondary and tertiary steps.

pieces.label: Filled icons
pieces.note: Navigation icons on soft green tiles, drawn from Material Symbols.

pieces.label: Line icons
pieces.note: A lighter line set for actions in toolbars and menus.

pieces.label: Buttons
pieces.note: Primary, secondary, neutral and destructive buttons, sharing one shape.

pieces.label: Appointment statuses
pieces.note: Visit chips that say where an appointment stands at a glance.

pieces.label: Anatomical body map
pieces.note: The region being treated, highlighted on the body, here the shoulder.

pieces.label: Streak cards
pieces.note: Weekly goal and activity streaks, each with its count and a badge.

pieces.label: Clinical data cards
pieces.note: Care-plan actions, and pain and PSFS scores with their change.
